the PTEN status in prostate cancer is associated with overall survival and disease-specific survival, and that the PTEN loss in prostate cancer is correlated with the Gleason score.
the PTEN status is a prognostic marker in prostate cancer and that the loss of PTEN is a prognostically significant event.
